description: F2 regression — preserve-path service (ta): verbatim=true must return the full path unchanged. /ta/indicators must resolve to /ta/indicators, NOT /indicators. The technical-analysis service registers routes at its own /ta/* prefix; stripping /ta produces an upstream 404.
note: verbatim=true is computed at call site as svc.NoProbe || svc.PreservePath. For ta: NoProbe=false, PreservePath=true → verbatim=true. Scenario input uses noProbe=true as the boolean value that reaches the resolver. This golden scenario validates the verbatim guard is operative for ta.
